title: I Didn't Know Claude Code Had This Built-In Repair Tool
description:
The /doctor command inside Claude Code checks your setup health, trims plugins and skills you never use, cleans up a bloated CLAUDE.md, and pre-approves the commands you keep approving anyway. It frees up your context window, which means better outputs from Opus 5 and Fable 5. Full walkthrough with exact commands and file paths for Windows and Mac in the free guide below.

Get the full guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/19Fxdr2FhvMrxZ9hZH8S9wmS8Z-iaSPCwAxN-fwoCiwE/edit?usp=sharing
